bus.via: Barcelona, Estació d'Autobusos Nord to Figueres - Estación de Autobuses

trips.route_note: Take a high-speed AVE or regional train from Barcelona-Sants or Passeig de Gràcia to Figueres-Vilafant or Figueres, about 1 to 1.5 hours; the Dalí museum is a short walk from the station.
see: Dalí Theatre-Museum
Castell de Sant Ferran
Dalí Jewels Museum
Rambla and old town of Figueres
Dalí's birthplace and Plaça del Gala
trips.tour_query: Figueres and Dali Museum day trip from Barcelona
trips.why: The train takes about 53 minutes and the Dalí museum is a short walk from the station, far quicker than the 2h 45m bus.
know: The Dalí Theatre-Museum is the reason to visit, so prioritise it.
Book museum tickets ahead, especially in peak season.

bus.via: Barcelona, Estació d'Autobusos Nord to Girona, Estació d'Autobusos

trips.route_note: Take a high-speed AVE or Rodalies regional train from Barcelona-Sants or Passeig de Gràcia to Girona, about 40 to 90 minutes depending on service; the old town is a short walk from the station.
see: Girona Cathedral and its long Gothic nave
Call (Jewish Quarter) and Museu d'Història dels Jueus
Colourful houses along the Onyar River
City walls and Passeig de la Muralla
Game of Thrones filming locations
trips.why: The train takes about 26 minutes and the old town is a short walk from the station, which beats the 1h 45m bus.
know: The old town is compact and best explored on foot.
Book high-speed AVE tickets ahead if travelling at peak times.

bus.via: Barcelona, Passeig de Gràcia to Tarragona

trips.route_note: Take a regional train (R14 Rodalies or regional service) from Barcelona-Sants to Tarragona, about 1 to 1.5 hours; the Roman sites are a short walk or bus ride from the station.
see: Roman Amphitheatre by the sea
Roman Circus and Passeig Arqueològic
Tarragona Cathedral
Medieval old town and Part Alta
Museu Nacional Arqueològic de Tarragona
trips.why: The train takes about 30 minutes and the Roman sites are a short walk or bus ride from the station.
know: The Roman sites are the main draw, so allow time for them.
Trains are fast and frequent compared with the 1h 45m bus.

bus.via: Barcelona to Sitges - Parc Can Robert

trips.route_note: Take the R2 Sud Rodalies train from Barcelona-Sants or Passeig de Gràcia directly to Sitges, about 40 minutes, then walk to the beach and old town.
see: Old town (Vila) and its whitewashed streets
Church of Sant Bartomeu i Santa Tecla on the seafront
Playa de la Ribera and Playa de Sant Sebastià
Museu Romàntic
Carnival and Film Festival atmosphere, seasonal
trips.why: The train takes about 28 minutes and runs very frequently, dropping you close to the beach and old town.
know: Trains run very frequently, so you rarely need to plan around a timetable.
Go in warmer months for the beach; it is much quieter outside summer.
